text:
tess: Heads-up: saw a few customers getting billed twice when our router falls back from org-key to project-key. Example trace `t-cc9a` shows both org and project counters incremented.
omar: yikes. probably the meter-lib is incrementing at auth decode and again after resolution.
shiv: we should surface a single canonical billing owner downstream. Proposal: auth-router writes `X-Quota-Owner` once resolution is final; meter-lib prefers that header for billing counters and treats other owner labels as lineage only.
console-team: dashboards currently group by `owner` label. Changing to `X-Quota-Owner` will need a migration layer so panels don't break overnight.
tess: rollout plan: feature-flag the header emission in router, add backward-compat in meter-lib (if header missing, fallback to legacy owner), emit metric `quota.owner_mismatch` when both exist and differ.
omar: tests: s/ request with org-key -> fallback to project -> assert only project billing increments when flag on. s/ request without header -> legacy behavior.
shiv: I'll open PRs for router + meter-lib. We'll canary in staging for 24h and monitor `quota.owner_mismatch` and `billing.total_delta` panels.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary started on staging cluster at 14:12 UTC, image auth-router:v2-quota-header.
console-team: we'll add a toggle in quota table to show "attribution lineage" collapsed by default and add a compatibility mapping for older dashboards.
tess: also add an alert: if mismatch ratio > 0.5% sustained for 30m post-deploy, trigger page to oncall and rollback the flag.
omar: tagging finance for a quick reconciliation run after full rollout.
shiv: PRs up shortly, will include unit tests + an integration test harness to replay traces.
